metadata.author: Patrice Portemann
metadata.description: Certified realizations of KO-6 finite spectral triples under the Krajewski amendment.

minimal_solution.notes: The absolute minimal realization: A_F = C^2, H_F = C^7, m = [[0,2],[2,3]]. All four minimality bounds (T1-T3) are saturated here.

theorem_summary.T2: R=3, zero chiral: dim_HF >= 7, k >= 2, max(m_ij) >= 3 (proved by arithmetic obstruction)
theorem_summary.T3: 63,160 certified realizations saturate all four bounds
theorem_summary.T4: M_min(R) = sqf(R) if R odd, 1 if R even (general multiplicity law)

negative_results.description: On nodal set (C ⊕ H ⊕ M_3(C)), all margins are even; sqf law does NOT constrain number of generations N.
